page.overview:
Who is Chorazin?

The Chorazin is an avatar of Cthulhu created by Chaosium for their role-playing game Call of Cthulhu.

The psychic manifestation of Cthulhu's will, the Chorazin appears as an ethereal representation of its "parent" entity, but can only make its presence known through the dreams and nightmares of those nearby. Using this method to spread madness and chaos, the Chorazin will slowly absorb the insanity it creates and, once it reaches a critical mass, explodes into our dimension in a flash of raw energy. This mass will gestate over the course of the next twelve hours, until finally a full-size representation of Cthulhu with all of its powers and abilities emerges. Once manifested in this way, the Chorazin is only vulnerable to electricity and certain types of magic.
